title: Sufficiently Size Me, Too
description: Sufficiently Size Me, Too — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle off Level 7 of MutantMania. Smash Ravishing Reginald and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle off Level 7 of MutantMania. Smash Ravishing Reginald and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Money's getting a bit tight, friend. Ah need you to go back to the Sufficiently-Sized Scuffle and mix it up with Ravishing Reginald, one of their highest-tier fighters. Highest tier. It's a joke, friend. You missed it.

Turn-in:

Good job with that fight against Ravishing Reginald. Ah'm certain you gave his career a boost. It's a joke, friend. You missed it.

Objectives:

  • Smash Ravishing Reginald

Client level range: 86–96
